authorization_change: WHO GAINS UPLOAD: a non-Opal viewer whose verified edge token names firm F (x-firm-id) and whose class is FIRM_ADVISOR or FIRM_OPERATIONS, and only for firm F, and only when all four conditions hold: the subject's canonical users PROFILE row has status exactly 'active' and an explicit allowedFirmIds list that names F (not empty, no ALL member, no non-string member); the subject has a partner row in opal-partner-F; and the retained owner of the upload is also firm F. At this vintage that is the advisors and firm-operations users of 49financial, inflection and cottonwood (the enabled client firms in data/firm_registry.json), each for its own firm only. STILL REFUSED NOT_AUTHORIZED before the file is read: a viewer of another firm; a token with no verified firm; a firm named only in a body or query; an inactive, disabled or unknown-status user; a profile without the firm or with ALL; a subject with no partner row for the firm; a profile or partner row for another email; a reader that raises or returns nothing; CLIENT, RENDER_DELEGATE and UNKNOWN classes; and every Opal principal, whose path is unchanged (the producer never consulted for OPAL_GLOBAL). The same callable also reaches the owned-input analysis route (ProspectSubmissionFactory, prospect_submission.py:55-56), so the same viewers gain that route for their own firm's inputs on the same four conditions; the ruling named the upload door only, so the CTO must rule on that route before any release (surprise row IRPT_ANLREQ-D2-W120-S2). Built only: nothing is released, and the never-widen pair that ships it is the issuer's.
